sentence_of_record: JUDGE-BY-CELL: on the 9,123 matches judged by three STACK-v2 draws on identical bytes (Mistral-Large-3; grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning through Python and through Kotlin), 4,495 key-decidable, no anchor shows a judge winning by more than the 5.7pp bar (C1 FAILED on the 7 scored anchors; max |M - grok| 3.2pp at History, an UNDETERMINED cell, CI including 0; Law -1.8pp [-4.0, -0.4] under B on both draws, inside the bar, above the same-judge floor), the same-judge floor is 2.3pp (A) / 0.0 (B) (C3 HELD), and a per-cell judge choice cross-fitted over 100-500 splits loses 0.1-0.2pp against the best single judge with an oracle ceiling of +0.6pp (C2 FAILED, robust). Under this recipe committed verdicts follow the reference-agreeing side 97% of the time (the draws are independent; dual-order TIE-on-flip turns their disagreement into ties), so the judge model is ~3% of the committed verdict and the convention-B bar is unreachable by construction; closure rests on convention A. P1, P2, P4, P5 HELD; P3, P6, P7 FAILED; falsifier not fired. The record's own-committed B figures 0.9178 / 0.9155 / 0.9172 reproduce ARENA-V2 / GROK-CALIB / JUDGE-WIRING-BOARD.

plain_description.what: On 9,123 matches judged by two cheap judge models (Mistral-Large-3 and two runs of grok), it checks, per MMLU-Pro subject area, whether one judge beats the other by more than the judge's own retest noise (5.7 points). It also checks whether picking the best judge per cell beats using one judge everywhere. No calls.
plain_description.why: Earlier work found that the recipe, not the judge model, carries the gain. This test checks whether that still holds cell by cell, or whether judges should be routed by query type.
plain_description.information: A stable per-cell winner would reopen judge choice as a property of the cell. Result: done. On the 7 subject areas with enough questions to score, no judge wins beyond the noise bar (largest gap anywhere 3.2 points, not significant). The other 7 areas are undetermined because they have too few questions. Choosing a judge per cell loses 0.1-0.2 points against the single best judge. Judge routing by cell is closed for this pair of judges and this recipe, on the scored areas. Later ruled history rather than evidence, because it ran on the older question pool.
